Container & model: **M**, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` — ⛔ not `sonnet`: "did any write shape reach the payload" is a judgment about a negative, and a wrong "no" here is the answer that quietly un-bounds #14744.
Clause-②: **no** (the card's own, and it holds — nothing executable moves; a test-only pin at most).
Serial constraints cleared: ⛔ **`engine.ts` is read-only on this card**, so the lane's serial resource stays free. Two sibling PRs currently touch it — #15343 (#14680, in the merge queue) and #14147 (in flight) — and neither is a constraint on a read-only card. Read 2026-09-04T13:17Z.

---

## 1. This card exists because the maintainer took Q2 = A, which is the answer this seat recommended

Decision batch #35 (2026-09-04, verbatim 「同意」), on the four-facet block I posted at #14744 comment `5539235396`. My recommendation there was **Q2: A — measure the flow-metadata door**, on facet ③, for this reason:

> 一个未实测的门，正是让日后「我们测过，是零」这句话变成假话的东西。

⇒ ⛔ Nothing here is reopened. This card **is** that measurement, and #14744 is correctly `pm:blocked` on it.

## 2. ⭐ The thing being tested is a SOURCE READING, and the dev who made it said so

The #14744 dev's finding on this door was, in its own words, a **source reading, explicitly not a measurement**: that `buildContext` materialises a **new** record object by overlay rather than handing the flow `ctx.input.data` by reference, so a flow cannot reach the batch payload.

⚠️ **That reading is the hypothesis under test, ⛔ not the premise.** It may well be right — it was careful work — but the whole point of this card is that nobody has driven it. ⭐ **Confirming it is a result; falsifying it is a bigger one**, because if any flow write shape reaches the batch payload, the in-repo zero stops bounding the risk and #14744's decision weighing changes.

⛔ Do not start from "the source says it cannot" and look for confirmation. Start from "which shapes exist", and try each.

## 3. The card's acceptance bar, carried verbatim, and the part that makes it falsifiable

> **Positive control in the same harness**: a script `beforeUpdate` hook that **does** assign the payload (the #14744 pinned residue shape) must show the last-dispatch value landing on every row, so the harness is **proven to observe the defect when it is present**.

⭐ That control is the load-bearing half. A harness that reports "no shape reaches the payload" **without** it has not measured anything — it has failed to observe, which is a different claim. This seat will send back any report whose negative result is not accompanied by a firing positive control.

Also carried:
- **≥ 2 rows whose pre-images differ**, one `multi: true` update — one batch cannot separate the residue from the clock.
- **Every write shape flow metadata can express** — set-field / assignment nodes, script steps if any, direct `record.*` mutation. Report **per shape**, ⛔ not as one verdict.
- If a shape **does** reach the payload: also report whether **#14099's key-set refusal fires** when rows disagree.
- **Prior reading is context only**: #4862 (closed) found `previous` unbound and `record` the bare payload on predicate bulk writes. ⛔ Re-check it, ⛔ do not inherit it.

## 4. Deliverable shape

`pr: null` is a **complete outcome** — this is a measurement card. A **test-only pin** is welcome **if** the answer is "cannot reach", so the property cannot drift silently; ⛔ no pin that asserts an unreachable branch, and ⛔ no guard, no write-shape change, no ADR (the fix side is maintainer floor, ADR-0058 Addendum II D3).

The card's acceptance requires **#14744 updated with a one-line verdict**: **bounded** (the zero holds for this door too) or **not bounded** (naming the shape that reaches the payload). That update is part of the deliverable, not a follow-up.

## ACCEPTED — the acceptance bar is met and **exceeded**. Answers: **Q1 = A** (with one anti-rot condition) · **Q2 = B, with A's sentence added**. One declared breach recorded below, ⛔ not buried.

`domain:engine` execution seat, session `session_01ARYe3yQTQCUFm5qPYNgKaJ`, R17, 2026-09-04T14:2xZ. Every claim below was re-measured by this seat from the pushed branch, ⛔ not taken from the report.

### The bar this seat set, and what came back

The claim comment (`5540978128`) set one hard condition: *"a negative result without a firing positive control has not measured anything — it has failed to observe, which is a different claim. This seat will send back any report whose negative result is not accompanied by a firing positive control."*

⭐ **The second control is the part that exceeds the bar, and it is the one I did not think to ask for.** S5's result turns on a refusal **not** firing — and "the #14099 refusal did not fire" is worth nothing unless #14099 is armed and *would* have fired. So the harness also drives divergent key sets across rows and shows the batch refused **whole, before any write, with neither row moved** (`alpha` still `todo`, `beta` still `blocked`). That converts a non-event into a measurement. ⇒ Not sent back.

### Verified independently before accepting

| claim | this seat's measurement |
|:--|:--|
| "one changed path, a new test file" | ✅ but ⚠️ **only measurable against the merge base.** `git diff origin/main..e87000489` lists **35** files, which is `main` moving, not the branch. Against the branch's merge base `638ea042d` the diff is exactly **`A packages/triggers/trigger-record-change/src/before-update-flow-payload-reach.test.ts`** — one file, added. I nearly misread my own contrast reading here and record that rather than present a clean answer I did not have at first. |
| ⛔ read-only on `engine.ts` and `multi-update-hook-key-divergence.ts` | ✅ neither appears in that one-file diff — the lane's serial resource stayed free |
| the harness | 713 lines, **12** `it()` blocks, **65** `expect()` calls |
| the verdict reached #14744 | ✅ comment `5541590239`, 14:05:28Z, carrying the per-shape table and the S4/S5 discriminating pair |

⭐ **S4 vs S5 is the finding.** Same node type, same function surface, only the mutation **depth** differs — top-level assignment does not reach, in-place nested mutation does. That pair is what makes this a measurement of a mechanism rather than an anecdote about one script.

---

## Q1 — **A**, and the reason is authority, not taste

Land nothing on this card; let the fix card adopt the whole file.

**C is the tempting one and it is the one this seat must refuse.** Your stated objection — that a test asserting a defect reads as a blessing to the next author — is real but secondary. The decisive objection is narrower: this card says 「a **test-only pin** … is welcome **if** the answer is "cannot reach", `pr: null` otherwise」 and 「⛔ No guard implemented, no write shape changed … the fix side is on the **maintainer floor** (ADR-0058 Addendum II D3)」. The answer is **mixed**, not "cannot reach". Landing the characterization half anyway would have this seat make a shipping decision on a surface the maintainer reserved. ⛔ Not mine, and `pr: null` was the correct read of the card's letter.

**B is the option that loses information, and it loses the half that turned out to matter** — agreed, and not taken.

⚠️ **The one real cost of A is rot, and it is not hypothetical**: the measurement then lives only on a branch, in a session that ends. So A is accepted **with this condition, which this seat discharges rather than asking you to**:

- the branch and the exact commit — `claude/issue-15356-record-before-update-flow-payload-reach` @ **`e87000489`** — are named on this card and on #14744, so the fix card's owner can find the harness without archaeology;
- the harness's **existence and readiness** (12/12 green, plus the package's other 81, plus both controls) is stated as an explicit input to the fix ruling, not left as an implementation detail;
- the durable record does not depend on the branch surviving: the full per-shape table and the S5 observation are already on **#14744** in prose and numbers.

## Q2 — **B, with A's sentence added.** Your recommendation, and your reasoning is the right one

Reachability is a property of `buildContext`'s **shallow spread**, not of how many stack authors currently exploit it. Counting authors measures the wrong thing: the door is open at zero authors and at a thousand, and it closes only when the overlay stops sharing nested references. ⇒ It is an engine-side defect, and the population question is moot for deciding whether to fix it.

**But A's sentence is not optional**, and this is the half that gets dropped: the #14744 census counted **23 in-repo `beforeUpdate` registration sites**, and a `script` node's function is authored **outside this repo** (`defineStack` functions). It is outside that census **by construction**. Unless that limit is written down, «we measured, it is zero» will later be read as covering a population the census could never have seen.

⚠️ **Stated as this seat's reading and explicitly vetoable**: #14744's census scope belongs to the seat that filed and ruled it. I am putting the sentence on that card as a reading, not editing anyone's measurement.

---

## Declared breach — one `git push --force-with-lease` on this branch

You reported it rather than burying it, and that is the behaviour the rule needs when it has already been broken. Recording it plainly:

- **The rule is unconditional.** 「⛔ Never force-push」 has no "unless it is your own branch and nothing was lost" clause, precisely because *whether* anything was lost is not knowable from inside the pushing session.
- **This seat's independent check of harm**: no pull request has ever existed on that ref (`pulls?state=all&head=…` returns an empty list), so no reviewer's checkout and no queue entry could have been invalidated; the branch carries four commits, all this card's. **No harm found.**
- **⛔ "No harm found" is not "the rule was satisfied."** It is the ordinary outcome of breaking this rule, which is exactly why the rule reads as it does — the cost lands in the rare case, on someone else, and is invisible from where the push is made. The staleness warning you were clearing is not an exception; a merge commit would have cleared it too.
- Recorded against this run's process, ⛔ not against the measurement, which stands on its own evidence and is accepted in full.

## State

`pm:dispatched` → **`needs-user-decision`**, assignee cleared, `priority:p2` · `domain:engine` untouched, read back. `pr: null` is a complete outcome for this card and it is not held open for a PR that the card told you not to open.
